name: Crwydro
nav.label: Main
language.label: Language
status.not_logged_in: Not logged in, so entries stay on this device.
banner.offline: Dim signal? Dim problem. Entries are saved on this device.
banner.auth: Log in again to sync. Your entries are safe on this device.
entries.title: Entries
entries.empty_body: Spotted something on the hill? Log it, signal or not.
entries.choose: Choose an entry to see it here
entries.choose_hint: Or press New entry to log something.
entry.delete_confirm: Delete this entry? It will also be removed from the server when you next sync.
entry.missing: This entry isn’t on this device
entry.sync_error_hint: Edit the entry to try again, or use Retry on the Sync page.
form.title: Title
form.title_required: Give it a title, even a short one.
form.location_hint: Location and time are added when you save. GPS works without signal.
form.gone: This entry is no longer on this device.
form.saved_without_location.denied: Saved without location: location access is turned off for Crwydro.
form.saved_without_location.unavailable: Saved without location: no GPS fix yet.
form.saved_without_location.unsupported: Saved without location: this device has no GPS.
photos.label: Photos
photos.remove_confirm: Remove this photo? It hasn’t been uploaded yet.
photos.unreadable: That photo couldn’t be read. Try another.
walks.title: Walks
walks.intro: Featured routes are saved on this device, so you can attach entries to them with no signal.
map.offline: Offline: the base map only shows areas you viewed with signal. Routes and your entries are always here.
sync.title: Sync
sync.intro: Entries are saved on this device first and copied to your account whenever there’s a signal.
sync.not_signed_in: Not signed in. Entries stay on this device until you log in.
sync.when_body: When you open the app, when signal returns and whenever you save.
sync.background_yes: This browser can also finish syncing after you close the app.
sync.background_no: Keep the app open for a moment when you get signal so it can finish.
sync.offline: Can’t reach the server yet. Crwydro will try again when signal returns.
sync.interrupted: Signal dropped mid-sync. Nothing was lost; it will pick up where it left off.
sync.auth: Log in again to carry on syncing.
login.title: Log in to sync
login.intro: You can keep logging entries without an account. Logging in backs them up to the server.
login.session_ended: Your session ended. Log in again to carry on syncing. Nothing on this device has been lost.
login.needs_signal: Logging in needs a signal. Your entries are safe on this device until then.
login.too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
web.login_intro: Use the same email and password as the app.
web.login_pitch: Every entry from the hill, on one map.
web.login_pitch_body: Log in to review what you’ve synced from your phone, and download it as GPX or CSV.
web.remember: Keep me logged in on this computer
web.synced_count: {0} No synced entries|{1} :count synced entry|[2,*] :count synced entries
web.nothing_synced: Nothing synced yet. Entries appear here once your phone has had a signal.
